app.title: Sketch Village
app.subtitle: Defend the village you drew yourselves

camera.title: Take a photo
camera.hint: Put the paper on the table, well lit and fully visible.
camera.error_unsupported: This browser can't use the camera.
camera.error_denied: Camera is blocked. Allow it in the browser.

bg.title: Remove the paper
bg.hint: Use the slider to choose how much paper disappears. Checkerboard = transparent.
bg.inside: Also erase paper inside the drawing

editor.name: Name
editor.author: Drawn by
editor.levels_hint: Each upgrade level has its own drawing. A missing level uses the previous drawing.
editor.need_name_image: Name or first drawing is missing

catHint.hero: The main character. Give it skill points.
catHint.enemy: Monsters that attack from the caves.
catHint.townhall: Town hall in the village centre – 3 levels.
catHint.decoration: Trees, rocks, flowers for the map.

import.error_not_json: This is not a game data file.
import.error_wrong_format: This is not a Sketch Village file.
import.error_newer_version: The file is from a newer version of the game.
import.error_generic: The file could not be loaded.

data.title: Save & load
data.export_hint: One file with all drawings, maps and settings. Take it to another computer.
data.import_hint: Adds drawings and maps from the file. Nothing is deleted; the newer version wins.
data.purge_hint: Download everything first, just in case.
data.confirm_purge_all: Really delete ALL drawings and maps? This can't be undone.

maps.title: Maps
maps.empty: No maps yet. Paint a new one or start from the sample.
maps.name: Map name
maps.no_decorations: Draw some decorations in the Drawing studio first.
maps.hint_road: Yellow road – you can walk on it. Lead roads from the map edge to the centre.
maps.hint_grass: Green grass – nobody can walk on it. Works as an eraser for roads.
maps.hint_pencil: Draw decorations. Careful: a line across a road blocks it.
maps.hint_fill: Fill an area with one colour.
maps.hint_place_centre: Click where the town hall stands. It must be next to a road.
maps.hint_place_spot: Click next to a road – buildings will go here. You need 10 spots.
maps.hint_place_cave: Click near the map edge where a road ends. The cave snaps to the edge.
maps.hint_place_decoration: Pick a decoration and click on the map. Decorations don't block walking.
maps.hint_place_erase: Click the thing you want to remove.
maps.valid: The map is ready to play!
maps.problem_no_paths: There is no yellow road on the map.
maps.problem_centre_off_path: The town hall must be next to a road.
maps.problem_spot_count: There are {{n}} building spots, {{want}} are needed.
maps.problem_spot_far: Spot {{n}} is too far from a road.
maps.problem_cave_not_edge: Cave {{n}} must be on the map edge.
maps.problem_cave_off_path: Cave {{n}} is not next to a road.
maps.problem_cave_not_connected: No road leads from cave {{n}} to the town hall.
maps.problem_respawn_off_path: The hero start must be next to a road.

play.title: Play
play.no_maps: No map is ready. Create one under Maps.
play.no_heroes: No heroes – you'll play with a stick figure. Draw a hero in the Drawing studio.

game.hint: Click a road = walk · click an enemy = attack · drag = move view · wheel = zoom · 1/2 = sword/bow · space = Ready
game.ready_hint: Start the wave now – every second saved earns coins
game.msg_cant_hit: Flying enemies can only be hit with the bow (2)!
game.msg_hero_down: The hero fell! Back in {{s}} s.

enemies.title: Enemies
enemies.hint: Pick a drawing from the studio for each enemy and set its numbers. Changes apply to all maps.
enemies.confirm_reset: Reset all enemies to the default values?

waves.title: Waves – {{map}}
waves.confirm_reset: Replace all rounds with the default 20 rounds?
